# fastpath_lab_benchmark — minimal runtime requirements.
#
# The lab benchmark uses TensorRT + torch + numpy + matplotlib only.
# No OpenCV, no pypylon, no ultralytics, no Pillow.
#
# IMPORTANT: torch and tensorrt must be CUDA-enabled builds matching
# your local CUDA Toolkit. The pip wheels below are the simplest path
# on a fresh machine with a recent NVIDIA driver. If you already have
# torch + tensorrt installed (e.g. in conda), you only need numpy and
# matplotlib.
#
# Tested combination (matches the RTX 2080 Super baseline):
#   torch     2.5.1+cu121
#   tensorrt  10.16.x
#   numpy     1.26.x
#   matplotlib 3.x

numpy>=1.24
matplotlib>=3.6

# torch + tensorrt are NOT pinned in this file because the right
# wheels depend on the local CUDA Toolkit. The recommended install is:
#
#   pip install --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu121 \
#        torch==2.5.1
#   pip install tensorrt==10.16.*
#
# (You may need `pip install tensorrt-libs tensorrt-bindings` on
#  some distributions; check `python -c "import tensorrt"` afterwards.)
